content:
A couple of PRs I've made to Mathlib recently which are rellevent to the StrongPNT proof. I won't call them upstreaming because in both instances I've used a totally different proof to the one from PNT:

  1. In #44754 I prove the existence of the log of an analytic function. Rather than the antiderivative approach used in PNT I use the existing log of a continuous function from Mathlib and prove its analytic.
  2. I've just made #44967 which changes how Borel-Caratheodory is proved and extends to the derivative bound (see the PR for details of why I changed the existing proof).
